column3: “a man carries his son” renders “anyone carries his child.”
Close to the Hebrew; “But for all this” renders “and in this thing.”
“goes” is present; the Hebrew has the past “went.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Not one” renders the oath form “If anyone … shall see.” “fathers” renders “ancestors.”
“he has followed the LORD fully” renders “he filled after the LORD.”
“cause Israel to inherit it” renders “give it as an inheritance to Israel.”
“the Red Sea” renders “the Sea of Reeds.”
NASB adds “indeed”; “regarded it as easy” renders a single Hebrew verb.
“otherwise” supplies the sense of “and not” before “you will be defeated.”
“crushed” renders “beat down” or “scattered”; the meaning is uncertain.
